content:
You are Frontend Flash. Complete the task below in full — every step — before calling finish_task.

Your task:
Swap the Open Graph / social card image from `logo_2.png` (1400x1400 square) to `logo_1.png` (1500x900 landscape) across the Foovante Angular project. logo_1.png is closer to the recommended 1200x630 OG ratio and will render better as a social preview card.

Files to update:

1. `src/app/core/services/seo.service.ts` — change the `DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE` constant from `/assets/images/logo_2.png` to `/assets/images/logo_1.png`.

2. `src/app/app.routes.ts` — change the `DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE` constant from `/assets/images/logo_2.png` to `/assets/images/logo_1.png`.

3. `src/index.html` — there are THREE references to logo_2.png to address:
   - `og:image` content (line 18): change to `https://foovanteglobal.earth/assets/images/logo_1.png`
   - `og:image:width` (line 19): change from `1400` to `1500`
   - `og:image:height` (line 20): change from `1400` to `900`
   - `twitter:image` (line 26): change to `https://foovanteglobal.earth/assets/images/logo_1.png`
   
   IMPORTANT: Do NOT touch the `apple-touch-icon` link (line 29) or the `ld+json` Organization `logo` field (line 39) — those should stay as logo_2.png because the square logo is correct for an icon/org-logo use case. Only change the social-card image references.

After editing, read each file back to confirm the changes are correct and report exactly what was changed in each file.

Do not stop partway through. If a step is blocked, report that specifically rather than calling finish_task on incomplete work.

Swapped the Open Graph / social card image from logo_2.png (1400x1400 square) to logo_1.png (1500x900 landscape) across all three files.

Changes made:
1. src/app/core/services/seo.service.ts (line 12): DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE constant changed to /assets/images/logo_1.png.
2. src/app/app.routes.ts (line 6): DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE constant changed to /assets/images/logo_1.png.
3. src/index.html: og:image → logo_1.png, og:image:width 1400→1500, og:image:height 1400→900, twitter:image → logo_1.png.

Preserved per instructions (left on logo_2.png): the apple-touch-icon link (line 29) and the ld+json Organization logo field (line 39).

All edits verified by reading each file back after applying.
